review.reading: a grid / hash / basket-weave square; the visible-mending cliché

ideas.hook: a camp pot seen from the side, its two lug handles sitting on top as the two dots of an ö

ideas.hook: a round cloth patch sewn on slightly askew, its edge a ring of short running stitches, nothing inside

ideas.hook: three filled circles of decreasing size in a slow curved line, like a caravan of stones seen far off

ideas.hook: a bedroll / rolled blanket seen end-on as a tight spiral, tied with one strap

ideas.hook: a heybe: two square woven pockets hanging either side of one broad band, the Anatolian nomad's saddlebag seen flat

ideas.hook: a lowercase ö whose round counter is darned shut with three thick horizontal weft bars, the umlaut dots left plain

review.reading: a circle with three horizontal lines under two dots: a hamburger-menu icon or a striped-mouth face; again a lone letter symbol

ideas.hook: the word göçebe drawn as one thick round cord laid on cloth, every letter a single monoline loop with soft round ends, the ö dots and ç cedilla short cut ends of the same cord

review.reading: the word göçebe in a thick rounded cord, dots and cedilla as cut cord ends; risk it reads as a generic monoline neon/app wordmark unless the cord's thickness, laid turns and cut ends feel hand-made

ideas.hook: three flat river stones balanced in a short, slightly crooked stack, each a different soft oval

review.reading: a stack of balanced stones: the hiking cairn / zen-spa cliché
